Message:
—Heh heh heh...!
That was quite the entertaining performance.
Do enjoy what little time you have left.

I felt the inhuman presence
fade into the distance.

As my consciousness began to dim,
a warm light shone down on me.
Then, someone gently lifted me
into their arms.

My pain began to disappear.
This light... It was the same as
the one that saved me that day...
Her light...

“As I was trapped in that vast,
endless darkness...
I heard your voice.
I heard you say,
‘I want you to live’...”

Ahh...
This really is Lady Elfriede...

I gazed into her eyes and
saw the same warm glow as
on the day we first met...
“My voice...reached you...?”

“Yes. Your voice was the shimmer
of radiance that saved me.
...Thank you, Alexandra.”

At last...I saved her.
Thank goodness...
With this, I no longer have
anything to regret.

“Your wish...
could not come true
due to my defiance.
So please...
pass your judgement
upon me...”

“I am a weak and foolish sinner—
a mere human.
That means I may
lose my way again.

Thus...I ask you...
Will you continue protecting me...
as my knight?”
“I need you... Alexandra.”

Even after what I’ve done...
you still need me...?

If so, I must honor
the faith you have in me.

“Of course! I shall dedicate
my life to standing by your side...
as your shield.

And, should you ever
lose your way, I will be the one
who guides you back
to the right path.”

Thus, I make my decision,
devoid of any hesitation.

Even if it means
defying your wishes,
I shall protect you.
And this time...
—If you live, I’ll live...with you...
